meta.title: ANATOMICA assembled cardiovascular layer — Milestone 16
meta.canonical_frame: centimetres; x+ = subject right, y+ = up, z+ = anterior (Phase-1 convention)
meta.transform: app = (-bp_x, bp_z, -bp_y) * 0.1; signed permutation, determinant -1 vs canonical handedness
meta.winding: triangle winding flips under this transform; shells must flip index winding (or culling/normals) at import
meta.mesh_set_rule: IS-A composition primary; PART-OF only where IS-A is empty; byte-identical duplicates within a composition de-duplicated
meta.partof_rollup_note: 62 records list PART-OF files beyond their IS-A composition. In these modules the PART-OF lists of whole-concept records are descendant rollups (branches' meshes belonging to other records), not the record's own geometry; under the mesh-set rule they are not assembled into the record. (In the muscular module the PART-OF set was a subset of IS-A for every record — verified at Milestone 6; that property does not hold here and is not asserted.)
flagged_unknowns: Register_sketch unknown 1: a single global frame for all concepts was assumed at Milestone 3 for soft tissues and measured coherent for the muscular layer at Milestone 6. This assembly applies the skeletal transform unchanged to every system; per-layer coherence against the skeletal envelope is measured by tools/assembly_check_all.py, not assumed here.
Ground placement (canonical y=0 at sole) and AP origin registration are NOT applied — frame conversion only, exactly as Milestone 3.
Per-part pose registration is not performed; boxes are in the source pose.
